# QR Code Generator

> A free, private, browser-only QR code generator. All encoding happens on the
> user's device: no account, no upload, no tracking and no backend. The codes it
> produces are standard static QR codes that never expire and never redirect.

## What it does

- Content types: website URL, plain text, Wi-Fi (SSID, password, security type),
  vCard, email, SMS and phone number.
- Design: foreground/background colours, module shape, error-correction level,
  quiet-zone margin, transparent background and an optional centre logo
  (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB).
- Guardrails: refuses to export when foreground/background contrast falls below
  WCAG 4.5:1, and caps the centre logo at a size verified to still decode.
- Export: PNG (512–4000 px) and SVG, each including the four-module quiet zone
  the QR specification requires.

## Canonical facts

- Free: yes, with no paid tier.
- Sign-up: none required.
- Tracking or analytics: none.
- Data handling: entirely client-side; the content is never transmitted.
- Code lifetime: static and permanent — no expiry, no redirects, no subscription.
- Open source: MIT licensed.
